caption: The drawing depicts a symmetrical folk art motif centered around a red floral element with a large, circular, red flower at the top, which contains small yellow circular dots within it. Two red stems curve outward from the central floral stalk, each supporting a geometric starburst shape with yellow inner triangles and blue and white concentric circles and zigzag patterns in the center. Below and to each side of these starbursts are stylized yellow birds facing inward, each with blue, wavy line accents on their wings. Red, leaf-like shapes and blue accents are present near the birds and at the base of the composition, flanking the main red stem. The background is a beige color, and the overall design uses primarily red, yellow, blue, and white colors. The text at the bottom reads, "FROM SLIPWARE PLATE LATE 18th CENTURY," and there are additional notations in small print at the lower margin.
title: Plate 11: From the Portfolio "Folk Art of Rural Pennsylvania"
